newsitem.title: UK: Bridges starts Irish freight courier operation.
newsitem.headline: Bridges starts Irish freight courier operation.

text.p: UK-based independent wholesale express courier operator Bridges Worldwide said it has expanded its activities to Ireland.

The company said in a statement it is now offering Republic of Ireland courier operators a global ex-Dublin airport-to-airport service to 30 international hubs, including Johannesburg, Tokyo, Singapore, New York and Los Angeles.
Bridges' Irish operation is headed by Robert Monks, who has 10 years' airline industry experience.
He said the main focus of the new service is to provide a quality wholesale service dealing exclusively with the air cargo and express freight industries.

"The most important issues for Irish courier companies are good communications, a reliable network and speed of delivery. As with Bridges Worldwide in the UK, we are not dealing with the high street retailer -- we are a neutral, wholesale organisation," said Monks.
